# Best Buy
> Best Buy is a consumer electronics retailer offering online shopping, store services, support resources, memberships, and developer APIs.

Best Buy’s web presence spans ecommerce, customer support, store and order services, trade-in and recycling programs, memberships, business purchasing, and a long-standing developer platform for product and store data.

## Shopping & Product Categories
- [Best Buy Home](https://www.bestbuy.com/): Main ecommerce homepage for shopping electronics, appliances, computing, and featured deals.
- [TV & Home Theater](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/tv-home-theater/abcat0100000.c): Browse televisions, streaming devices, projectors, audio, and home theater accessories.
- [Computers & Tablets](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/computers-pcs-tablets/abcat0500000.c): Shop laptops, desktops, tablets, monitors, components, and computer accessories.
- [Cell Phones](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/mobile-cell-phones/abcat0800000.c): Explore smartphones, unlocked phones, carriers, plans, and mobile accessories.
- [Appliances](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/appliances/abcat0900000.c): Shop kitchen and laundry appliances, small appliances, and appliance packages.
- [Video Games](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/video-games/pcmcat148600050011.c): Find consoles, games, gaming accessories, and digital gaming products.
- [Audio](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/audio/abcat0200000.c): Browse headphones, speakers, sound bars, receivers, and portable audio gear.
- [Cameras & Camcorders](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/cameras-camcorders/abcat0400000.c): Shop digital cameras, lenses, drones, camcorders, and photography accessories.

## Deals, Outlet & Promotions
- [Top Deals](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/top-deals/all-electronics-on-sale/pcmcat1563309784494.c): Central deals hub for discounted electronics, appliances, and limited-time offers.
- [Deal of the Day](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/promo/deal-of-the-day): Daily featured promotion with limited-time pricing on selected products.
- [Outlet](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/outlet-refurbished-clearance/pcmcat142300050026.c): Clearance, open-box, refurbished, and outlet inventory across major categories.
- [Best Buy Drops](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/best-buy-drops/best-buy-drops/pcmcat1662472733307.c): Limited-release and special-access product drops for selected items and brands.
- [Black Friday](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/black-friday/pcmcat225600050002.c): Seasonal Black Friday deals hub for holiday promotions and doorbuster events.
- [My Best Buy Member Deals](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/clp/my-best-buy-member-deals/pcmcat309300050007.c): Exclusive discounts and offers available to My Best Buy members.
- [Student Deals](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/back-to-school/student-deals/pcmcat748302045455.c): Student-focused promotions on laptops, tablets, accessories, and dorm essentials.

## Support, Orders & Account Help
- [Customer Service](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/customer-service/pcmcat204400050018.c): Support hub for orders, returns, payments, subscriptions, and account assistance.
- [Order Status](https://www.bestbuy.com/order-lookup): Look up purchase status, shipping progress, and order details.
- [Returns & Exchanges](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/customer-service/return-exchange-policy/pcmcat260800050014.c): Official return and exchange policy with timelines, conditions, and exceptions.
- [Shipping, Delivery & Store Pickup](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/customer-service/shipping-delivery-store-pickup/pcmcat204400050019.c): Information on shipping methods, delivery options, and pickup services.
- [Manage Account](https://www.bestbuy.com/identity/global/signin): Sign in to manage purchases, saved items, memberships, and account settings.
- [Product Recalls](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/product-recalls/pcmcat114100050002.c): Recall notices and safety information for affected products sold by Best Buy.

## Geek Squad & Tech Services
- [Geek Squad](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/geek-squad/geek-squad/pcmcat138100050018.c): Main hub for tech support, setup, repair, and protection services.
- [Computer & Tablet Services](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/computer-tablet-services/computer-tablet-services/pcmcat138100050015.c): Setup, troubleshooting, repair, and optimization services for computers and tablets.
- [TV & Home Theater Services](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/tv-home-theater-services/tv-home-theater-services/pcmcat138100050020.c): Installation, mounting, calibration, and support for TVs and home theater systems.
- [Appliance Services](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/appliance-services/appliance-services/pcmcat138100050021.c): Delivery, installation, repair, and haul-away services for appliances.
- [Car Electronics Professional Installation](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/car-electronics-professional-installation/car-electronics-professional-installation/pcmcat1496786342474.c): Installation services for car audio, remote start, dash cams, and related products.
- [Protection Plans](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/protection-plans/pcmcat1594152111966.c): Device protection options including service plans and accidental damage coverage.

## Memberships, Programs & Trade-In
- [My Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/my-best-buy/my-best-buy/pcmcat309300050007.c): Loyalty program with points, member pricing, and purchase tracking benefits.
- [Best Buy Total](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/best-buy-membership/best-buy-total/pcmcat748302046616.c): Paid membership with protection, support, and member-exclusive pricing benefits.
- [Best Buy Plus](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/best-buy-membership/best-buy-plus/pcmcat748302046615.c): Membership tier focused on exclusive pricing and shopping perks.
- [Trade-In Program](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/services/best-buy-trade-in/pcmcat133600050011.c): Estimate value and trade in eligible electronics for Best Buy gift cards.
- [Recycling](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/services/recycling/pcmcat149900050025.c): Electronics recycling program details, accepted items, and in-store recycling information.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/gift-cards/gift-cards/pcmcat121800050005.c): Purchase physical and digital gift cards for Best Buy purchases.

## Stores, Pickup & Local Services
- [Store Locator](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/store-locator): Find nearby Best Buy stores, hours, services, and contact details.
- [In-Store Pickup](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/customer-service/shipping-delivery-store-pickup/pcmcat204400050019.c): Learn how store pickup works for online and same-day orders.
- [Outlet Events & Open-Box Shopping](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/outlet-refurbished-clearance/pcmcat142300050026.c): Access local and online open-box, clearance, and refurbished inventory.
- [Store Services](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/store-locator): View store-specific offerings such as Geek Squad, pickup, and installation support.

## Business, Education & Marketplace Programs
- [Best Buy Business](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/best-buy-business/best-buy-business/pcmcat1648748434988.c): Business purchasing solutions for technology, appliances, and commercial support needs.
- [Education](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/education/pcmcat1497484594569.c): Technology shopping resources and offers for students, teachers, and schools.
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/health-wellness/pcmcat1563309784491.c): Devices and solutions for fitness, wellness, and connected health monitoring.
- [Marketplace & Partner Offers](https://www.bestbuy.com/): Best Buy storefront includes products sold directly and through partner assortments.

## Developer Platform & APIs
- [Best Buy Developer Portal](https://developer.bestbuy.com/): Official portal for Best Buy APIs, account access, and developer resources.
- [API Documentation](https://developer.bestbuy.com/documentation): Documentation for available APIs, authentication, and request structure.
- [Products API](https://developer.bestbuy.com/documentation/products-api): Reference for querying product catalog data and product attributes.
- [Stores API](https://developer.bestbuy.com/documentation/stores-api): Reference for store locations, hours, services, and geographic queries.
- [Categories API](https://developer.bestbuy.com/documentation/categories-api): Access category hierarchy and taxonomy data for Best Buy products.
- [Commerce API](https://developer.bestbuy.com/documentation/commerce-api): API information for carts, checkout-related workflows, and commerce integrations.
- [Query Builder](https://developer.bestbuy.com/documentation/query-builder): Interactive tool for constructing and testing Best Buy API queries.
- [Getting Started](https://developer.bestbuy.com/getting-started): Introductory guidance for obtaining keys and making initial API requests.

## Corporate, Careers & Investor Information
- [Best Buy Corporate](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/): Corporate site with company news, leadership, strategy, and governance information.
- [About Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/about-best-buy/): Overview of the company, mission, operations, and business profile.
- [Newsroom](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/news/): Corporate announcements, press releases, and company news updates.
- [Careers](https://jobs.bestbuy.com/): Job search portal for retail, corporate, supply chain, and technology roles.
- [Investor Relations](https://investors.bestbuy.com/): Financial reports, SEC filings, earnings materials, and shareholder information.
- [Sustainability & ESG](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/esg-report/): Environmental, social, and governance reporting and related initiatives.

- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/legal/terms-and-conditions/pcmcat204400050067.c): Legal terms governing website use, purchases, and related services.
- [California Privacy Rights](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/privacy-policy/california-privacy-rights/pcmcat204400050063.c): State-specific privacy disclosures and consumer rights information.
- [Accessibility](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/accessibility/accessibility/pcmcat1492030054979.c): Accessibility statement and information on accessible shopping experiences.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/privacy-policy/privacy-policy/pcmcat204400050062.c): Privacy controls and disclosures related to personal information sharing.
